meta.name: paid-ads-integrations
meta.description: Discover, connect, and verify NotFair paid-ad integrations and their actual capabilities. Use when asked to connect an ad account, configure an ads MCP, check available tools, troubleshoot access, or determine whether NotFair can read or change a platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接广告账户并核验平台的实际读写权限
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在连接广告账户前想搞清平台到底支持哪些读写操作
copy.tagline_en: Connect ad accounts and verify what the platform can actually read or change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect an ad platform and know exactly which operations are available

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先检查可用工具，连接广告平台前先做无害的账号或读取验证，记录平台、所选账号、可访问日期范围及只读/可修改状态；授权失败时报错并给出连接路径，不编造路由、工具名或账号 ID。
howto.when: 当用户要求连接广告账号、检查可用工具，或排查访问权限时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接 Google Ads 账号，先确认有读取权限。
say.note: Claude 会先验证 Google Ads 的账号访问权。

say.text: 检查一下当前 NotFair 能访问哪些广告平台？
排查 Meta Ads 连接失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会检查 Meta 连接并给出修复路径。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude inspects tools, verifies account access via a harmless read, logs platform/account/date/read-only status, and never invents routers, tools, or IDs. It reports errors and gives the documented path on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to connect an ad account, check available tools, or troubleshoot access issues.

say_en.text: Help me connect my Google Ads account, first confirm read access.
say_en.note: Claude will verify Google Ads account access first.

say_en.text: Check which ad platforms NotFair can currently access.
say_en.note: Claude will call listConnectedPlatforms to list connected platforms.

say_en.text: Troubleshoot why the Meta Ads connection is failing.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the Meta connection and provide the fix path.
